---
title: "Supplementary Time-Series Explorer"
site: workflowr::wflow_site
output: workflowr::wflow_html
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
```

```{=html}
<link rel="stylesheet" href="assets/supplementary/supplementary_app.css">
```

Select any registered analysis family, geography, age group, and sex. The
mortality view shows observed deaths and the posterior median expected deaths
with a central 95% posterior predictive interval. The P-score view summarizes
\((Y_t-E_t)/E_t\) draw by draw at each observed date.

```{=html}
<div id="supplementary-timeseries" class="supp-app" data-supplementary-app="timeseries" data-root="assets/supplementary">
  <div class="supp-controls" aria-label="Time-series filters">
    <label>Analysis family
      <select data-control="family"></select>
    </label>
    <label>Geography
      <select data-control="geography"></select>
    </label>
    <label>Age group
      <select data-control="age"></select>
    </label>
    <label>Sex
      <select data-control="sex"></select>
    </label>
    <label>Display
      <select data-control="metric">
        <option value="mortality">Observed and expected mortality</option>
        <option value="pscore">Pointwise P-score</option>
      </select>
    </label>
  </div>

  <div class="supp-meta" data-role="metadata"></div>

  <div class="supp-chart-shell">
    <svg data-role="chart" viewBox="0 0 920 480" role="img" aria-label="Selected mortality analysis time series"></svg>
    <div class="supp-tooltip" data-role="tooltip" hidden></div>
  </div>

  <div class="supp-actions">
    <button type="button" class="btn btn-default" data-action="download">Download selected series</button>
    <span class="supp-status" data-role="status" aria-live="polite">Loading frozen supplementary index…</span>
  </div>
</div>

<noscript>This explorer requires JavaScript. The complete summary tables remain available from the <a href="supplementary.html">supplementary landing page</a>.</noscript>
```

The center line in the mortality view is the posterior median. The downloadable
pointwise table also retains the posterior mean. Values are displayed on their
native source frequency: weekly, monthly, or quarterly. Missing and failed
cohorts are shown explicitly rather than replaced or silently removed.

```{=html}
<script src="assets/supplementary/supplementary_app.js"></script>
```
